name: The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder
description: Follow the adventures and misadventures of newly 14-year-old Penny Proud and her family as they navigate modern life with hilarity and heart. The 2020s bring a new career for mom Trudy, wilder dreams for dad Oscar and new challenges for Penny, including a socially woke neighbor who thinks she has a lot to teach her.

videos.title: New Kids on the Block
videos.overview: Penny, desperate to prove she's not superficial, joins new girl Maya's poorly planned plot to free a panda from the zoo. Meanwhile, Penny's crew vie for a new boy's attention.

videos.title: Bad Influence(r)
videos.overview: Frustrated by her friends' obsession with a makeup influencer, Penny becomes an influencer herself but the fame quickly goes to her head.

videos.title: It All Started with an Orange Basketball
videos.overview: An overzealous Oscar bets big that his AAU basketball team can beat Wizard Kelly's. He forces Penny onto his team but her heart isn't in it because she'd rather spend time with her crush.

videos.title: Father Figures
videos.overview: When Penny discovers who Maya and KG's parents are, she becomes the lone voice of tolerance in her community, butting heads with her father Oscar's prejudices.

videos.title: SnackLand
videos.overview: Oscar opens a slap-dash theme park that, despite it's poorly designed and extremely dangerous rides, becomes an overnight success. Penny struggles with her changing singing voice.

videos.title: Get In
videos.overview: After her parents forget to pick her up, Penny starts a rideshare company aimed at kids whose parents are too busy to drive them.

videos.title: When You Wish Upon a Roker
videos.overview: Frustrated by Oscar's overbearing parenting, Penny wishes to be grown up. Al Roker grants her wish, turning Penny and her friends into college coeds.

videos.title: Home School
videos.overview: Penny inadvertently gets her homeless teacher, Ms. Hill, fired. To right her wrong, Penny starts a fundraiser. Zoey turns to Uncle Bobby to learn the ways of the funk.

videos.title: Raging Bully
videos.overview: LaCienega feels threatened by her ugly-duckling-turned-beautiful-swan cousin, LaBrea, as her quinceañera approaches; Sunset's sister, Melrose, goads her into making poor choices.

videos.title: Old Towne Road
videos.overview: When Trudy tracks Suga Mama's family to Oklahoma, the Proud's head to the family rodeo, where Suga Mama's painful history will be revealed; Oscar discovers he's a natural cowboy.

videos.title: Old Towne Road (2)
videos.overview: Realizing nothing has changed, Suga Mama decides to run away from Oklahoma yet again but when a man from her past catches up to her, she decides to prove her father wrong and stay.

videos.title: Grandma's Hands
videos.overview: When Penny becomes increasingly rebellious, Trudy banishes her to Suga Mama's house, where Penny receives old school tough love.

videos.title: Curved
videos.overview: When Dijonay starts dating the most interesting teen in the world, her friendship with Penny suffers, making Penny increasingly jealous and scared their friendship may not survive.

videos.title: A Perfect 10
videos.overview: When LaCienega becomes an overnight gymnastics sensation, her friends and family cash in on her success, putting immense pressure on LaCienega not to fail.

videos.title: Puff Daddy
videos.overview: When Puff is accused of being the father of the Boulevardezes' dog's litter of puppies, Oscar and Felix fight over who will be responsible. Penny, meanwhile, interns for a tough boss.

videos.title: The End of Innocence
videos.overview: When Zoey is asked to the dance by a boy all the girls have a crush on, the crew are forced to confront their complex emotions. Meanwhile, Suga Mama grows jealous of a friend whom Papi takes a liking to.

videos.title: The Soul Vibrations
videos.overview: Penny and crew discover that Oscar and Uncle Bobby were once part of a famous R&B group, leading to a retelling of the group's epic rise and abrupt fall.

videos.title: Us Again
videos.overview: At a time of major family friction, the Proud family awaken to a bizarro version of their world only to discover they're being held hostage by Dr. Carver's clones.

videos.title: BeBe
videos.overview: After BeBe goes missing only to inexplicably wind up in bizarre places, the Prouds have him checked out and discover he's on the autism spectrum.

videos.title: Juneteenth
videos.overview: Maya befriends a strange new girl at school who reveals that Smithville's founder was a slaveowner, leading to a major protest by Maya and her friends.

videos.title: Proud Family-Verse (1)
videos.overview: The Proud Family's Paris vacation goes haywire.

videos.title: Proud Family-Verse (2)
videos.overview: The Proud Family journeys to Brazil to save Dijonay.

videos.title: The Shade of It All
videos.overview: Penny and her crew redefine beauty pageant standards.

videos.title: O Mother, Where Art Thou?
videos.overview: Penny helps Maya find her birth mother.

videos.title: Game Changer
videos.overview: Penny enters a male-dominated video game tournament.

videos.title: Forward to the Past
videos.overview: Al Roker grants thirty-five-year-old Maya an unexpected wish.

videos.title: Will the Real Young Toddler Please Stand Up?
videos.overview: Penny investigates the true identity of Young Toddler.

videos.title: Wiz Kid
videos.overview: Penny tests into the Wiz Kids program.

videos.title: Wild, Lost, and Free (1)
videos.overview: Penny and Kareem are forbidden to see each other.
